subject: general
question: The construction of the _______ in Rajasthan is based on the theme of nine planets.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawahar Kala Kendra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jawahar Kala Kendra:**

 
 
• **Multi arts centre located in the city of Jaipur, India**.
 
• **It was built by the Government of Rajasthan with the purpose of preserving Rajasthani arts and crafts**.
 
• **The plan of Jawahar Kala Kendra, inspired by the original city plan of Jaipur**, consists of **nine squares with a central square left open**.
 
• The **centre **consists of **eight blocks housing museums, one Amphi theatre and the other closed auditorium, library, art display rooms, cafeteria, small hostel and art studio.**
 
• Also **houses two permanent art galleries and three other galleries. and hosts its own theatre festival each year.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raj Bhavan Chikitsalaya**

 
 
• It is** located in Jaipur and is one of the leading businesses in the Clinics.**
 
• **This well-known establishment acts as a one-stop destination servicing customers both local and from other parts of Jaipur.**
 
 
 
• **Jain MM Emitra**
 
 
• It is a** hospital located in Ganganagar, Rajasthan.**
 
• It is the **major hospital in Jaipur and Rajasthan state of India**.
 
• This** government hospital is staffed with 1500 doctors and 4000 nurses with 6251 beds in 43 wards and daily more than 10000 OPD.**
 
 
 
• **Raj Palace**
 
 
• **The Raj Palace is an imposing palace hotel that holds you spellbound.**
 
• **The hotel houses 50 luxurious rooms and suites.**
